decision: Base close-crop direction acceptable but actual refs currently UI only. Attach reviewed R26c actual output to preserve same note/paper/word/desk/lamp/position before generating. No architecture gate remains if crop respected.
design_scope: Static image generation only; one current speaker, KO+DE exact text, one CTA, C materials, no clouds/coins/settings/tabs, no learning UI
postflight_required: Anatomy, identity per character, relative scale, gaze/acting, prop support, scene state, exact copy, dimensions/framing all reviewed from actual output
limits: No user approval/canon promotion/metric certification/runtime-save/Flutter-device proof
